hero.description: Design, web and mobile apps — dreamed up, drawn, coded and shipped by a single pair of hands. No handoffs, no telephone game, one owner from first sketch to launch.

insight.title: Reliability: Uptime in prod
insight.body: Every product is built to keep running — monitored, maintained and answered for, long after launch.

studio.title: The studio
studio.lead: CloudSheep is the one-person product studio of Dušan Pavlović — engineer of electrical engineering and computing, University of Niš.
studio.body: You work directly with the person who designs the interface, writes the code and answers for the result. One brain holding the whole product means fast decisions, no lost context, and a single owner for quality.

design.title: Product Design
design.description: UX flows, UI systems and clickable prototypes that are designed to be built — not just admired.

web.title: Web Development
web.description: Fast, maintainable web apps — from marketing sites to dashboards with real data models.

mobile.title: Mobile Apps — iOS & Android
mobile.description: One codebase or fully native — chosen per project, shipped to both stores.

ops.title: Backend, APIs & Care
ops.description: The unglamorous part done right: APIs, deployments, monitoring and long-term maintenance.

discover.title: Discover
discover.description: A call and a written brief. We define what success looks like before anything is drawn.

design.title: Design
design.description: Wireframes to hi-fi, quickly. You review a clickable prototype, not a PDF.

build.title: Build
build.description: Weekly shippable increments on a staging link. You watch the product grow, not wait for it.

ship.title: Ship & care
ship.description: Launch, monitoring and support. The studio stays reachable after the invoice.

pricing.title: Three ways
pricing.note: exact numbers after a short discovery call — every project is scoped individually

fixed.title: Fixed-scope build
fixed.description: A defined product, designed and built to a fixed scope and date.

monthly.title: Monthly partner
monthly.description: An ongoing seat at your table — product work shipped every week.

sprint.title: Design sprint
sprint.description: From idea to a tested, clickable prototype — fast.

onePerson.q: Is it really just one person?
onePerson.a: Yes — one engineer-designer doing the thinking, the pixels and the code. For specialised needs I bring in trusted collaborators, but responsibility never leaves this desk.

designDev.q: Do you do design and development together?
designDev.a: That's the whole point. Nothing gets lost between a designer's file and a developer's build, because they're the same person.

platforms.a: Yes. Usually one React Native codebase for both stores; fully native (Kotlin/Swift) when the product demands it.

duration.q: How long does a project take?
duration.a: A design sprint: 1–2 weeks. A typical product build: 8–16 weeks, shipped in weekly increments you can see on staging.

ownership.a: You do — 100%, from day one. Repos live in your organisation; there is no lock-in and nothing held hostage.

location.a: Niš, Serbia (CET) — a comfortable overlap with all of Europe and US mornings. Working languages: English and Serbian.
